    Clock - Class in com.sgware.serialsoc
    A thread that, once started, calls SerialServerSocket.tick() on a server and SerialSocket.tick() on each of its connected sockets at a regular interval on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run().
    Clock(SerialServerSocket) - Constructor for class com.sgware.serialsoc.Clock
    Creates (but does not start) a new clock thread for a given server with the default interval between ticks.

    Creates (but does not start) a new clock thread for a given server with a given interval between ticks.

    O

    onAccept(SerialSocket) - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    Runs each time a new SerialSocket connects to the server on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run().
    onClose() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    Runs after the server is closed, either because a method threw an exception, because a network problem disconnected the server, because the JVM shut down, or because SerialServerSocket.close() was called.
    onClose() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialSocket
    Runs after the socket is closed, either because a method threw an exception, because the network disconnected the socket, or because SerialSocket.close() was called.
    onConnect() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    Runs after SerialServerSocket.connect() (if it did not throw an exception) on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run().
    onConnect() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialSocket
    Always runs first when the socket connects to the server.
    onDisconnect() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    Runs after SerialServerSocket.disconnect() on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run().
    onDisconnect() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialSocket
    Always runs last just before the socket stops.
    onException(Exception) - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    If an exception is thrown at any time by one of the server's methods, it is reported to this method from the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run() (regardless of which thread the exception was thrown on).
    onException(Exception) - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialSocket
    If an exception is thrown at any time by one of the socket's methods, it is reported to this method from the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run() (regardless of which thread the exception was thrown on).
    onStart() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    Always runs first when the server starts.
    onStop() - Method in class com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
    Always runs last just before the server stops.
